BACHELOR OF ENGINEERING (CIVIL ENGINEERING) GEOMATICS ENGINEERING OPTION

1st & 2nd Semester

1st SEMESTER
Common to Aerospace, Biomedical, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Industrial and Mechanical Engineering Programs
Common to the Regular Program and the Geomatics Engineering Option
REQUIRED:
Introduction to Engineering
General Chemistry
Calculus I
Linear Algebra

Physics: Mechanics

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

2nd SEMESTER

Common to the Regular Program and the Geomatics Engineering Option

REQUIRED:

Digital Computation and Programming
Graphics
Principles of Engineering Economics
Calculus II
Materials Science Fundamentals
Physics: Waves and Fields

3rd & 4th Semester

3rd SEMESTER
Common to the Regular Program and the Geomatics Engineering Option
REQUIRED:

Strength of Materials I
Introduction to Geomatics
Geology for Engineers
Fluid Mechanics
Differential Equations and Vector Calculus
NOTE: All required core courses in 1st and 2nd semester are prerequisites to all required core courses in 3rd semester.

4th SEMESTER

Common to the Regular Program and the Geomatics Engineering Option
REQUIRED:

Strength of Materials II
Hydrology and Hydraulic Engineering
Geotechnical Properties of Soil
Electric Circuits
Statistics

5th & 6th Semester

5th SEMESTER

Common to the Regular Program and the Geomatics Engineering Option

REQUIRED:

Structural Analysis
Geomatics Measurement Techniques
Concrete Materials
Environmental Science and Engineering
Numerical Analysis

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table A .

6th SEMESTER

Common to the Regular Program and the Geomatics Engineering Option

REQUIRED:

Communication in the Engineering Professions
Transportation Engineering
Structural Concrete Design I
Highway Materials
Civil Engineering Systems

LIBERAL STUDIES: One course from Table B .

NOTE: Students who have a CLEAR Academic Standing may opt to enroll in the Industrial Internship Program (IIP). Eligible students should select WKT 90A/B on the course intention form.

7th & 8th Semester

7th SEMESTER

Revised Program Commencing Fall 2011

REQUIRED:

Satellite Geodesy
Photogrammetry and Digital Mapping
Geospatial Information Systems
Data Modeling and Estimation

Science Fiction
Technology and the Contemporary Environment
Scientific Technology and Modern Society
Religion, Science and Philosophy
Power, Change and Technology

8th SEMESTER

Revised Program Commencing Winter 2012

REQUIRED:
